correctness.rationale: The pairwise capacity identity is proved pathwise; the maximum is the smaller of the positive and negative extrema. Independent symmetric Skellam signs give an exact three-category multinomial event and inclusion–exclusion tail. Poisson point mass and Chernoff bounds yield \(\log p_k=-k\log k+O_{\lambda}(k)\); expectation follows from a summable Poisson-tail bound. Fixed-dimensional Poisson-difference CLT, continuous mapping and Mills ratio give the explicitly sequential Gaussian-minimum-of-Gumbels law. Full quantifiers, positivity, fixed-versus-sequential limits, and the 131 deterministic finite checks were examined; numerics are not used as asymptotic proofs.

value.rationale: Exactly one chosen fusion among C already reacted microreactors is a natural scarce-operation constraint. The distribution determines success reliability at finite C; at fixed occupancy its optimal expected increment grows as \(\log C/\log\log C\) whereas a predetermined pair has a finite fixed mean. The sequential high-loading limit predicts genuinely different Gaussian extreme fluctuations and flags the need to distinguish experimental loading/pool regimes. This is not merely evaluating a predetermined fusion tree.
